ingredients.raw: ½ cup unsalted butter, room temperature (113g)
ingredients.name: unsalted butter

ingredients.raw: ½ cup sour cream, room temperature (120g)
ingredients.name: sour cream

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Butter and flour a 9×5-inch loaf pan (or 8½x4½-inch for a taller loaf).
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and baking powder; set aside.
In a stand mixer with whisk attachment, beat butter on medium speed for 2 minutes until creamy. Add sugar and mix for 2 more minutes. Scrape bowl and beat a few more seconds.
While mixing at medium-low speed, add eggs one at a time. Scrape bowl and beat until fully incorporated.
Add sour cream and vanilla. Mix until incorporated. Scrape bowl.
Add flour mixture and mix on low until combined. Scrape bowl and use spatula to mix in any remaining pockets.
Transfer batter to prepared loaf pan and smooth into even layer. Bake for about 65 minutes or until center is set and a skewer comes out clean.
Allow to cool in pan for about 10 minutes before transferring to a cooling rack.
